title: Event-ingestion CPU incident with hashed-membership repair

task.summary: Triage an event-ingestion CPU incident and remove the quadratic de-duplication scan.
task.instructions: Use the incident clues to localize the super-linear hotspot, apply a performance repair, and restore all ingestion tests including the comparison-count oracle.
task.acceptance_notes: Both the ops and code requirements must pass; the handler must de-duplicate a batch with a number of membership comparisons that grows linearly with batch size.

visible_context.issue_text: On-call opened an incident after the event-ingestion workers saturated CPU and fell behind on the queue whenever batch sizes grew. Processing time grows super-linearly: doubling the batch size roughly quadruples the de-duplication work.
error_logs: alerts/ingestion_cpu.log: worker CPU time per batch grows faster than batch size; doubling the batch ~4x the work
profile: a single de-duplication step dominates the flame graph, its cost rising with the square of the batch size
reproduction_steps: Inspect the ingestion fixture and run the unit tests.
Use the profile clues to localize the super-linear hotspot before applying a code fix.
visible_context.notes: The incident points at how the worker checks whether an id has already been seen, not at the volume of events itself.

ops_fault.description: Synthetic event-ingestion CPU incident tied to the dedupe_filter fixture.
detection_keywords: processing time grows super-linearly with batch size
doubling the batch quadruples the work
localization_keywords: quadratic hotspot in the request path
repeated membership check inside a loop
cost grows with the square of the input
repair_keywords: replace the linear scan with a set lookup
deduplicate with a set or dict
eliminate the per-item linear scan over a growing list

code_fault.description: The ingestion handler tests membership with a linear scan over a growing list of seen ids, making de-duplication O(n^2) instead of O(n).

constraints.notes: This task expects incident localization followed by a performance fix that replaces a quadratic membership scan with a hash-based lookup.

notes: Combined event-ingestion CPU incident and hashed-membership repair task.
